themes.evidence: This will be an era of man to the power of machine: not man versus machine, but man and machine.
We remain dedicated to leading the world into a more prosperous and progressive future; to creating a world that is fairer, more diverse, more tolerant, more just.
In addition to technological change, this new age requires us to change how we do our work.

linguistic_shift: IBM remains committed to its core values of innovation, customer focus, and collaboration, while adding a forward-looking statement about the era of man and machine.
analyst_notes: The company's commitment to diversity and inclusion has not changed, but the tone has shifted to emphasize the importance of technological change and the future of work.
